context: An elderly couple share an autumn afternoon
purpose: Teach: 降る/掛かっ/代わっ/移り/握り/おしまい/握る/見当

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 初雪が降る前に、庭、片付けないとな。
lines.en: Before the first snow falls, I should get the garden sorted.
lines.style: Quiet, observational opening. Slight pause on the weight of seasonal routine. Slow, measured cadence. Speaking to himself as much as aloud. No urgency—acceptance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、毎年時間掛かってるわね。
lines.en: Yes, it always takes a while, doesn't it.
lines.style: Agreement wrapped in gentle memory. Warm recognition of the years this task has lived in their life. Soft agreement—not correcting, just understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今年は隣の娘さんが、代わってくれるって。
lines.en: This year, the neighbor's daughter said she'd help out.
lines.style: Light surprise held evenly. Information offered with quiet gratitude. Slight lift in the middle—noticing kindness without making it a big thing. Still measured.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 時の流れ、移り行くわね。
lines.en: Time really does just keep moving on, doesn't it.
lines.style: Philosophical exhale. Not sad, not cheerful—accepting. Speaks from lived experience. Trailing slightly on the ending, like watching something pass.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫が握り寿司を握る練習してる、夢中で。
lines.en: Our grandchild is practicing rolling sushi—really caught up in it.
lines.style: Gentle warmth breaking through. The pride in his voice is quiet but unmistakable. Small smile in the tone. Slight brighten on the image of them focused and learning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 夕飯、もうおしまいね。お風呂入る?
lines.en: Dinner's finished. Shall we take a bath?
lines.style: Practical shift into domestic care. Warmth without fuss. The natural rhythm of an evening together. Simple offer, genuine attention—checking in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前の手を握ると、いつも温かい。
lines.en: Your hand is always warm when I hold it.
lines.style: Vulnerability and tenderness in a single breath. Speaks quietly, directly—not performing, just offering truth. Soft attack on the opening. No embellishment, just the fact of it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 明日の予定、見当ついてないけど、ゆっくりしましょ。
lines.en: I don't know what tomorrow brings, but let's just take it slow.
lines.style: Contentment without needing answers. Quiet certainty in the not-knowing. Slight warmth underneath—this is enough. Gentle close, like settling into evening together.
